cta_caption: Comment FIX aur main full guide DM kar dunga 📩

slides.headline: CHECK 1: [ON] HAI?
slides.label: IN ORDER
lines: Automation **paused** toh nahi? **Start/end time** ke andar hai?

slides.headline: CHECK 2: [KEYWORD]
slides.label: IN ORDER
lines: Keyword **match** hua? **Excluded words** aur sahi **post** check karo.

slides.headline: CHECK 3: [7 DIN]
slides.label: IN ORDER
lines: Comment **7 din** se purana? Instagram us pe DM **allow nahi** karta.

slides.headline: CHECK 4: [REFUSED]?
slides.label: IN ORDER
lines: Instagram ne chat **refuse** ki? ReplyInbox **kai din** daily **retry** karta hai.

slides.headline: CHECK 5: [LIMIT]
slides.label: IN ORDER
lines: Viral reel pe **hourly limit**: sending **pause** hoke khud **resume** hoti hai.

slides.headline: [ACTIVITY] PAGE DEKHO
slides.label: WHERE TO LOOK
lines: Har event ki **error** simple words mein. **Logged out**? Phir se login, **alert** milega.
